editorialSummary.heading: What Northwest ISD families should know for 2026-2027
paragraphs: Northwest ISD approved its 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 instructional calendars together after community feedback. The district plans two school years at a time because families said advance notice helps them arrange vacations and work schedules. Both calendars keep traditional-length Thanksgiving, winter and spring breaks, with additional student holidays for teacher preparation.

For 2026-2027, students begin Wednesday, August 12. The first quarter ends October 8, followed by student holidays on October 9 and 12. Students are also off November 2–3 and for Thanksgiving week, November 23–27. The second quarter ends with early release on December 18.

Students have no classes December 21–January 5 and return January 6. February 12 and 15 are student holidays, and March 5 is a professional-learning day with no student attendance. Spring Break runs March 15–19, followed by a separate teacher-planning day on March 22; classes resume March 23. Students are also off March 26 and April 23. The school year ends with early release on Friday, May 21.
The calendar lists STAAR testing dates December 1–11 and April 6–30. That does not mean every student tests on every date. Families should confirm individual testing dates with their campus.

faqs.question: When does Northwest ISD start school in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Classes for Northwest ISD students begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the final day of school for Northwest ISD?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Friday, May 21, 2027. It is also an early-release day and the end of the fourth quarter.

faqs.question: What are the regular Northwest ISD school hours?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools run 7:40 a.m.-3:05 p.m., middle schools 8:50 a.m.-4:15 p.m., and high schools 8:25 a.m.-3:50 p.m. Hicks, Steele Early College, and the Special Programs Center follow separate times.

faqs.question: What hours does Hicks Early Childhood Center follow?
faqs.answer: Hicks Early Childhood Center runs from 8:05 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. and dismisses at 12:10 p.m. on district early-release days.

faqs.question: Does Steele Early College High School use different times?
faqs.answer: Yes. Steele Early College runs 8:15 a.m.-3:40 p.m. and dismisses at 12:20 p.m. on early-release days.

faqs.question: Is Northwest ISD closed on Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, September 7, 2026, is listed as a Labor Day Student-Staff Holiday. Students do not have classes.

faqs.question: Does Northwest ISD have a fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Northwest ISD does not label these dates as “Fall Break” on its adopted calendar. Students are off Friday, October 9, and Monday, October 12, creating a four-day weekend. Classes resume October 13.

faqs.question: Are students off November 2 and 3?
faqs.answer: Yes. November 2 is a student-staff holiday, and November 3 is a student holiday for teacher professional learning. Students return November 4.

faqs.question: What dates are included in Thanksgiving Break?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 23-27, 2026. The first two days are teacher-flex days, followed by three student-staff holidays.

faqs.question: When is Northwest ISD winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists student-staff holidays December 21, 2026–January 1, 2027. January 4–5 are separate student holidays for teacher professional learning, so students have no classes through January 5 and return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: Is Martin Luther King Jr. Day a Northwest ISD school holiday in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027, falls on Martin Luther King Jr. Day and is marked “Student-Staff Holiday” on the Northwest ISD calendar. Students have no classes.

faqs.question: Does Northwest ISD have a four-day weekend in February 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off Friday, February 12, and Monday, February 15, creating a four-day weekend. Classes resume Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Do Northwest ISD students have school on March 5, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 5, is a student holiday while teachers participate in professional learning.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break for Northwest ISD?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs March 15–19, 2027. March 22 is a separate student holiday for teacher planning. Classes resume Tuesday, March 23.

faqs.question: Are students off Friday, March 26?
faqs.answer: Yes. March 26 is a districtwide student and staff holiday.

faqs.question: Do Northwest ISD students have school on April 23, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, April 23, is a student holiday and teacher flex day.

faqs.question: Which dates have early release?
faqs.answer: Students are released early Friday, December 18, 2026, and Friday, May 21, 2027. Both dates end a grading quarter.

faqs.question: What are the Northwest ISD early-release times?
faqs.answer: Hicks dismisses at 12:10 p.m., elementary schools at 11:45 a.m., middle schools at 12:55 p.m., regular high schools and Special Programs at 12:30 p.m., and Steele Early College at 12:20 p.m.

faqs.question: When do the four grading quarters end?
faqs.answer: The quarter-ending dates are October 8, December 18, March 12, and May 21.

faqs.question: When are the STAAR testing windows?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists December 1–11, 2026, and April 6–30, 2027, as STAAR testing dates. These windows do not mean every student tests each day, and April 23 remains a student holiday. Families should confirm individual testing dates with their campus.

faqs.question: When is the Northwest ISD six-week UIL grade check in 2026?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists the six-week UIL grade check on September 18, 2026. It is not marked as a student holiday; families should confirm eligibility details with their campus.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official Northwest ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: Northwest ISD’s Calendars page provides the official 2026-2027 instructional calendar in English and Spanish. The PDF download on this page links to the district-hosted English calendar.

faqs.question: Can Northwest ISD change the adopted calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. The PDF says the calendar is subject to change, so families should confirm weather updates, testing schedules, transportation, and campus-specific events with Northwest ISD.

editorialSummary.heading: What Northwest ISD families should know for 2027-2028
paragraphs: The 2027-2028 calendar was approved alongside 2026-2027 as part of Northwest ISD’s two-year planning approach. Families asked for advance notice to arrange vacations and work schedules. This school year begins Wednesday, August 18, and ends Thursday, May 25.

Students have a four-day weekend October 8–11 after the first quarter ends October 7. November 1–2 are also student holidays, and Thanksgiving week is November 22–26. December 17 ends the second quarter and is an early-release day.

The December holidays run December 20–31. January 3–4 are separate student holidays for teacher professional learning, with classes resuming January 5. Students are also off January 17. In February, there are no classes on February 18 or 21. Spring Break is March 13–17, followed by two professional-learning days March 20–21; students return March 22. April 14 is another student holiday. May 25 ends the fourth quarter and school year with early release.

STAAR testing is shown by yellow shading rather than a printed list of date ranges. Shaded school dates fall between August 23–September 30, January 5–February 17 and May 1–24. These are planning windows, not daily exam assignments; weekends and student holidays remain outside the testing schedule. Families should confirm individual testing dates with their campus.
